description: This file defines a mock class for the IPlaybackService interface used in testing within the Rialto server service component. It includes mock method declarations for various playback service functionalities.

classes.name: PlaybackServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IPlaybackService interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Mocks the method to switch the playback service to active state.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Mocks the method to switch the playback service to inactive state.

methods.name: setMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Mocks setting the maximum number of concurrent playbacks.

methods.name: setMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Mocks setting the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: setClientDisplayName
methods.description: Mocks setting the client display name.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Mocks checking if the service is active.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the maximum number of playbacks.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: getShmBuffer
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getMediaPipelineService
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the media pipeline service reference.

methods.name: getWebAudioPlayerService
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the Web Audio player service reference.
